title: You can lose every title… and still not lose who you are.
paragraphs: You can lose every title… and still not lose who you are.
Read that again.
Because some of us built our identity on what people call us—leader, pastor, achiever, provider, influencer.

And when the title shakes…
we shake.

When the platform fades…
we panic.

When nobody applauds…
we start questioning our worth.
But here’s the truth we keep forgetting:
God never called you by your title. He called you by your name.
“And that’s where grace walks in.”

Before you preached.
Before you succeeded.
Before you proved anything—
Christ died for you.

Not your role.
Not your reputation.
You.
📖 “See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God.” — 1 John 3:1
Child.

Not brand.
Not status.
Not position.
Child.

Titles can be given… and taken.
But sonship? Daughterhood?
That was bought by the blood of Jesus—no one can strip that away.

So if everything else falls—
you still stand.

Because your identity is not in what you do.
It’s in what Christ has done.
And what He finished… is final.
We tell the stories that shame tried to erase.
